aboutText: Based in Maidstone, Artifical Grass has been transforming outdoor and indoor spaces with high-quality synthetic turf for over 10 years. Our team understands the unique needs of local homes and businesses, delivering tailored solutions that last. From hotels to tennis courts, we bring greenery without the maintenance.
servicesText: We offer a comprehensive range of artificial grass installations, from residential lawns to commercial projects. Our services are designed to provide durable, low-maintenance alternatives to natural grass.
